title: Pure Black Dinosaur
summary: Rex Raptor and Tyranno Hassleberry's classic Black Dinosaur series (Black Tyranno, Black Brachios, Black Veloci, Black Stego, and Black Ptera) paired with the modern Dinosaur engine (Souleating Oviraptor, Miscellaneousaurus, Animadorned Archosaur, Babycerasaurus, and Double Evolution Pill). By popping Babycerasaurus and Black Ptera, the deck swarms Level 4 Dinosaurs for Evolzar Rank 4s while cheating out Tyranno bosses from the Deck.

summary.title: Starters
points: Fossil Dig searches any Level 6 or lower Dinosaur from the Deck, finding Souleating Oviraptor, Miscellaneousaurus, Babycerasaurus, or any Level 4 Black Dinosaur.
Souleating Oviraptor searches or sends to the GY any Dinosaur on Normal or Special Summon, and destroys another Level 4 or lower Dinosaur on the field to revive a Dinosaur from the GY.

Miscellaneousaurus discards itself during either Main Phase to make all Dinosaurs you control unaffected by the opponent's activated effects, then banishes itself with Dinosaurs from the GY to summon Animadorned Archosaur from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Souleating Oviraptor + Babycerasaurus
steps: Normal Summon Souleating Oviraptor to search Babycerasaurus or Miscellaneousaurus, then discard Miscellaneousaurus and banish it from the GY to Special Summon Animadorned Archosaur from the Deck.
Archosaur destroys Babycerasaurus in the hand to search Double Evolution Pill, and Babycerasaurus triggers in the GY to Special Summon Black Brachios or Black Veloci from the Deck.

Overlay Oviraptor and the Level 4 Black Dinosaur into Evolzar Laggia or Evolzar Dolkka, then activate Double Evolution Pill by banishing a Dinosaur and a non-Dinosaur from the hand/GY to summon Ultimate Conductor Tyranno or Black Tyranno from the Deck.

summary.title: Black Ptera & Defense Position Synergy
summary.text: Black Ptera automatically returns from the GY to your hand whenever it is sent from the field to the GY except by battle, making it repeatable destruction or Link/Tribute material that always stays in hand for Animadorned Archosaur. On the offensive side, Black Brachios switches a monster on the field to Defense Position when Normal Summoned, and Ultimate Conductor Tyranno flips all opposing monsters into face-down Defense Position, directly enabling Black Tyranno to attack the opponent directly while they control only Defense Position monsters.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Ultimate Conductor Tyranno Special Summons itself by banishing 2 Dinosaurs from the GY, flips all opposing monsters face-down as a Quick Effect during either Main Phase, and attacks every monster the opponent controls while sending Defense Position monsters to the GY for 1000 burn damage.

Black Tyranno (2600 ATK) attacks the opponent directly when the only cards they control are Defense Position monsters, while Super Conductor Tyranno (3300 ATK) Tributes a monster to burn for 1000 damage.
Evolzar Laggia detaches 2 materials to negate a Summon or a Spell/Trap activation, and Evolzar Dolkka detaches 1 material at a time to negate monster effect activations twice per turn.

summary.title: Spells
points: Double Evolution Pill banishes 1 Dinosaur and 1 non-Dinosaur from your hand and/or GY to Special Summon any Level 7 or higher Dinosaur (Ultimate Conductor Tyranno, Super Conductor Tyranno, or Black Tyranno) directly from the hand or Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions.
Fossil Dig provides three extra copies of Oviraptor, Miscellaneousaurus, Babycerasaurus, or your Level 4 Black Dinosaurs without using your Normal Summon.

allow.Souleating Oviraptor: Core Dinosaur starter that searches or dumps any Black Dinosaur and destroys Black Ptera on field to revive another Dinosaur.
allow.Miscellaneousaurus: Protects all Dinosaurs on the field from activated effects and banishes Dinosaurs from GY to summon a Dinosaur from Deck.
allow.Babycerasaurus: Signature Dinosaur that summons a Level 4 or lower Black Dinosaur from the Deck when destroyed by card effect.
allow.Double Evolution Pill: Banishes a Dinosaur and a non-Dinosaur to summon Black Tyranno or Ultimate Conductor Tyranno from Deck.
allow.Animadorned Archosaur: Level 1 Dinosaur that pops Babycerasaurus or Black Ptera in hand to search Double Evolution Pill.
allow.Fossil Dig: Searches any Level 6 or lower Dinosaur monster from the Deck.
allow.Evolzar Laggia: Rank 4 Xyz made with Level 4 Black Dinosaurs that negates Summons and Spell/Traps.
allow.Evolzar Dolkka: Rank 4 Xyz made with Level 4 Black Dinosaurs that negates monster effects twice per turn.
